title: Quick (CV Karya Hidup Sentosa)
bottom_line: Quick is CV Karya Hidup Sentosa, a Yogyakarta partnership firm founded in 1953 by Kirdjo Hadi Suseno and Diah Wirasmi; Hendro Wijayanto runs it as president director (named by a third party in March 2022), and it calls itself fully Indonesian-owned, but its partners' stakes are not public. Its main outside tie is Kubota: Quick co-founded PT Kubota Indonesia in Semarang in 1972-73 and says it still holds shares (stake undisclosed) and is the main Kubota engine dealer, while the TKDN register shows Kubota RD diesels in 16 of its 18 certificates. It sells through about 450 dealers and its own branches, through Agriculture Ministry aid and the government e-catalogue (seen only in snippets), and abroad to Senegal and Panama with embassy help, which third parties confirm. Its foundry customers (Kubota Indonesia, Mitsuboshi, Freyssinet), foundry-equipment suppliers and design awards are company claims, and no investor, lender or formal university partner was found.

entities.name: Quick (CV Karya Hidup Sentosa)
entities.city: Yogyakarta (head office, Jl. Magelang 144); plant at Tuksono, Sentolo, Kab. Kulon Progo
entities.what: Farm-machinery maker started as a workshop in 1953: QUICK hand tractors, rotaries, cultivators, 4WD and transport tractors, QH-11 combine, gensets, castings; ~3,000 staff, 110,000 hand tractors/yr and up to 70% of the hand-tractor market (2017); 18 TKDN certificates at 35.87-83.09% (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Quick foundry (UPPL)
entities.what: In-house metal-casting unit (Unit Produksi Pengecoran Logam): 1.5 t and 0.5 t induction furnaces, 7,800 t/yr castings capacity (2017); casts exhaust manifolds, brake drums, cylinder blocks, couplings. No separate company found.

entities.name: Quick Truck (QT-14 transport tractor)
entities.what: Four-wheel rural transport tractor launched Oct 2017 (14 HP Kubota diesel, 600 kg payload, about Rp57-60M), sold to palm-oil estates and farmers; Quick says it won Good Design Indonesia Best 2021.

entities.name: Tokoquick.id
entities.what: Quick's "only official online store" (2016-2026): QUICK units and parts, KUBOTA parts, plus Bando, Nachi, Mitsuboshi, Bosch, SKF and NTN items.

entities.name: Quick dealers and branch showrooms
entities.what: About 450 independent dealers (2017, 2021) plus own branch showrooms (15 in 2018, 10 in 2021; 8 outside Yogyakarta listed in 2026: Medan, Kampar, Bandar Lampung, Cianjur, Nganjuk, Banjarmasin, Makassar, Palu); site locator shows 23 stocking dealers in 8 provinces.

entities.name: Kirdjo Hadi Suseno
entities.what: Founder of CV Karya Hidup Sentosa (1953); also spelled Kirjo Hadi Suseno. A Dec 2025 column says leadership passed to Hendro Wijayanto after his death.

entities.name: Diah Wirasmi
entities.what: Co-founder of CV Karya Hidup Sentosa (1953), named in a Dec 2025 column; the company says it was founded by a married couple.

entities.name: Hendro Wijayanto ("Binbin")
entities.what: President director (Direktur Utama) of CV KHS: quoted as its head in 2012, 2014 and 2017-18; listed as President Director at a NAM CSSTC event on 18 Mar 2022; a Dec 2025 column says he leads it as the founder's successor.

entities.name: PT Kubota Indonesia (PTKI)
entities.what: Kubota group maker of RD horizontal diesels (6.5-19 HP), vertical and petrol engines; set up Jul 1972 as a JV with CV KHS, operating since 10 Jul 1973; moved to BSB in 2014 (Rp351B, 120,000 engines/yr); capital Rp6.53B, 364 staff.

entities.name: Kubota Corporation
entities.what: Japanese farm-machinery and engine group; JV partner with CV KHS in PT Kubota Indonesia; set up PT Kubota Machinery Indonesia as a 100% subsidiary (2012).

entities.name: PT Kubota Machinery Indonesia (KMI)
entities.what: Kubota's 100%-owned seller of tractors, combines and rice transplanters (announced Jun 2012, capital Rp50B; 60 dealer outlets in 2023, snippet); a competitor in combines and 4WD tractors (inference); no Quick link found.

entities.name: Honda (GX engines)
entities.what: Engine maker; Honda GX200 petrol engines power Quick's Capung Metal tractor and Cakar Baja mini tiller (TKDN register); Quick offers a GX270 on the Impala. Indonesian supply channel not identified.

entities.name: Mitsuboshi Belting Indonesia
entities.legal_name: PT Mitsuboshi Belting Indonesia (Quick writes "PT Mitsuboshi Belting IND"; expansion inferred)
entities.what: Indonesian arm of Japan's Mitsuboshi Belting, reportedly set up Sep 1988 (snippet); named by Quick as a casting partner; Tokoquick resells Mitsuboshi products.

entities.name: Freyssinet Total Technology
entities.what: Named by Quick as a casting partner; the name reads as Freyssinet's Indonesian post-tensioning company (inference, not verified).

entities.name: Inductotherm (USA)
entities.what: Induction-furnace maker; Quick says its foundry combines Inductotherm (spelled "Indoctotherm USA"), Eirich and Sinto technology (Dec 2020).

entities.name: Eirich (Germany)
entities.what: Equipment maker named by Quick as part of its foundry technology (Dec 2020); no purchase record.

entities.name: Sintokogio (Sinto), Japan
entities.what: Equipment maker named by Quick as part of its foundry technology ("Sintokogio Jepang", Dec 2020); no purchase record.

entities.name: SGS
entities.what: Certification body; Quick says SGS issued its ISO 9001:2015 certificate ID08/01223.01.

entities.name: Kemenperin (Ministry of Industry)
entities.what: Runs the TKDN register (18 Quick certificates, BMP 15%); Minister Airlangga Hartarto visited Quick on 14 Nov 2017; put the Quick Truck in its rural-vehicle programme (2018).

entities.name: Kementan (Ministry of Agriculture)
entities.what: Farm-machinery aid buyer (Quick hand tractors in Brigade Pangan aid, snippet); its training centre co-ran a Mar 2022 farmer training for Senegal with Quick.

entities.name: Kemendag (Ministry of Trade)
entities.what: Runs Trade Expo Indonesia (Quick exhibited 2018, 2021) and Good Design Indonesia (with JETRO and Japan's design institute), which Quick says it won in 2021.

entities.name: LKPP (e-Katalog / INAPROC)
entities.what: Government procurement agency running the e-catalogue; snippets show CV KHS as provider of Quick hand tractors in the sectoral farm-machinery catalogue (Nov 2023).

entities.name: Solusi Klik
entities.what: Reseller listing Quick hand tractors (G 3000 Zeva, Amberjack rotary) on katalog.inaproc.id (snippet).

entities.name: KBRI Dakar (Indonesian Embassy in Senegal)
entities.legal_name: Kedutaan Besar Republik Indonesia di Dakar
entities.what: Promoted Quick at FIDAK 2021 and 2022 and backed the first QH-11 combine export (May 2022); Ambassador Dindin Wahyudin visited the Tuksono plant in Nov 2021 and Apr 2022.

entities.name: KBRI Panama (Indonesian Embassy in Panama)
entities.legal_name: Kedutaan Besar Republik Indonesia di Panama
entities.what: Showed Quick tractors at Expocomer 2024 (5-7 Mar 2024), where they were the Indonesian stand's most popular product.

entities.name: NAM CSSTC
entities.legal_name: Non-Aligned Movement Centre for South-South Technical Cooperation
entities.what: Intergovernmental technical-cooperation centre; ran the 2021-22 rice and farm-machinery training for Senegal and witnessed Quick's MoU with Manobi Africa.

entities.name: Manobi Africa
entities.what: Senegal-based company (CEO Daniel Annerose) that signed an MoU with CV KHS on 11 Mar 2022 on farm mechanisation in Senegal.

entities.name: DMC (Panama)
entities.what: Named by the Indonesian embassy as Quick's importer-distributor in Panama (Mar 2024); full name not given.

entities.name: FAO Timor-Leste
entities.legal_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
entities.what: UN agency office that tendered in Jan 2021 for 50 "Quick M1000 Alfa or similar" two-wheel tractors with spares and trailers; award not published.

entities.name: Pemkab Kulon Progo
entities.what: Host regency of Quick's Tuksono plant; Regent Hasto Wardoyo pledged full support in Oct 2012; joint vaccination drive with Quick in Sep 2021.

entities.name: Dinas Pertanian dan Ketahanan Pangan DIY
entities.legal_name: Dinas Pertanian dan Ketahanan Pangan Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta
entities.what: Provincial agriculture office; with FTP UGM it briefed farmer groups on "Impala" hand tractors given as aid in 2024 (Impala is a Quick model; maker not named).

entities.name: Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM)
entities.what: University; its agricultural-technology faculty trained farmer groups on aid "Impala" tractors (2024); a Dec 2025 column says Quick recruits from UGM and ITS. No formal Quick agreement found.

entities.name: Presidential special envoy for food security
entities.legal_name: Utusan Khusus Presiden Bidang Ketahanan Pangan
entities.what: Source of eight G 1000 two-wheel tractors handed out in Kulon Progo in Jul 2026 (snippet); G 1000 is a Quick model name.

entities.name: Tokopedia
entities.what: Marketplace; Quick store "quick1953" linked from tokoquick.id.

entities.name: Shopee
entities.what: Marketplace; Quick store "tokoquick" linked from tokoquick.id.

entities.what: Social-commerce channel; account @tokoquick.id linked from tokoquick.id.

links.detail: Founded the firm in Yogyakarta in 1953 as a small workshop with his wife; first product a rice huller.
Named as co-founder with Kirdjo Hadi Suseno (1953).
Listed as "President Director of CV Karya Hidup Sentosa" at the 18 Mar 2022 NAM CSSTC training; quoted as head of KHS since 2012; Dec 2025 column says he leads it as the founder's successor.
Co-founded the Kubota diesel-engine JV in Semarang: PTKI set up Jul 1972, operating 10 Jul 1973 (Quick dates it 1973); Kubota needed a local partner under the investment rules of the time.
Quick says it is a shareholder ("pemegang saham") of PTKI; stake undisclosed and not broken out in Kubota's filings.
Quick calls itself PTKI's main dealer; Tokoquick says CV KHS is "distributor utama PT KUBOTA INDONESIA" and sells KUBOTA parts; Quick also sells Kubota vertical diesels.
Kubota lists PTKI as a group production site and announced its Rp351B (about JPY3.16B) move to BSB, 120,000 engines/yr; stake not disclosed.
JV partner: Kubota partnered with KHS to form PT Kubota Indonesia; Quick had used Kubota diesels as its main power source.
100% Kubota: sales company for tractors, combines and rice transplanters, capital Rp50B (announced Jun 2012).
Kubota RD 65/85/110/150 diesels power 16 of Quick's 18 TKDN certificates (Kubota models up to 83.09%); Quick says the Quick Truck's 14 HP diesel is made by PTKI.
Named by Quick as a casting partner of its foundry.
Named by Quick ("PT Mitsuboshi Belting IND") as a casting partner.
Named by Quick as a casting partner.
In-house foundry unit (UPPL) of CV KHS with 1.5 t and 0.5 t induction furnaces; no separate company.
Quick says its foundry combines Inductotherm (USA), Eirich (Germany) and Sinto (Japan) technology; no purchase record.
Named in Quick's foundry-technology claim; no purchase record.
Named in Quick's foundry-technology claim ("Sintokogio Jepang"); no purchase record.
Honda GX200 petrol engines on the Capung Metal (40.17% TKDN) and Cakar Baja mini tiller (40.19%); Quick also lists a GX270 option for the Impala. Buying channel not stated.
Issued Quick's ISO 9001:2015 certificate ID08/01223.01 (certification service).

Minister Airlangga Hartarto visited on 14 Nov 2017, citing in-house components, ~3,000 staff, 100+ CNC machines and 450+ dealers; Quick also joined the ministry's Dec 2020 combine FGD (its claim); TKDN register holds 18 Quick certificates.
Kemenperin adopted the Quick Truck into its rural-vehicle programme; about 200 sold by Feb 2018.
Quick's own design, launched Oct 2017; body and parts made in-house, Kubota 14 HP diesel.

Ministry aid included 44 "Hand Traktor merek Quick" for 14 Brigade Pangan farmer groups in Siabu, Mandailing Natal (handed over Wed 12/3, probably 2025) (snippet); Kontan 2017 quotes Kementan naming CV KHS among private combine makers (snippet).

Kementan's training centre, Manobi Africa and CV KHS took part in NAM CSSTC's 18 Mar 2022 training for Senegal and Sierra Leone farmers, and the ambassador thanked both; Quick says Kementan wanted it in its Taxi Alsintan scheme (Dec 2021).

Quick exhibited at Trade Expo Indonesia (2018, 2021) and says it won Good Design Indonesia 2021 for the Capung Metal and Quick Truck ("Best"); Trade Minister Enggartiasto Lukita visited its IPOC 2018 booth.
CV KHS is listed as provider in the e-Katalog's sectoral farm-machinery catalogue, e.g. G 3000 Zeva + Kubota RD 85 DI-2S at Rp25.88M, TKDN 53.48%, Nov 2023 (snippet).
Resells Quick hand tractors on INAPROC (G 3000 Zeva, Amberjack; a two-wheel rotary at Rp40.1M, TKDN+BMP 57.99) (snippet).
Backed Quick at FIDAK Dakar (Dec 2021, Dec 2022) and its first QH-11 export (31 May 2022); IDN Times reported an "indication" of a 400-unit repeat order of Quick tractors for 2023.
Showed Quick tractors at Expocomer 2024; the embassy called them the Indonesian stand's most popular product.
"DMC as the Quick distributor in Panama"; Expocomer visitors placed orders through DMC.
MoU signed 11 Mar 2022 as a framework for farm mechanisation in Senegal; follow-up training planned in St Louis (May-Jun 2022).
Witnessed the KHS-Manobi MoU and ran the Senegal rice-training programme; Quick says it sent a hand tractor there for field trials.
Tender 2021/FATIM/FATIM/108405 (15 Jan 2021) for 50 "Quick M1000 Alfa or similar" two-wheel tractors with spares and trailers; no award published, so a purchase is not confirmed.
Regent Hasto Wardoyo said officials and residents back the Tuksono plant "seratus persen" (Oct 2012); joint vaccination drive in Sep 2021 (Quick's claim).
Gave "Impala" hand tractors to farmer groups in Sleman, Bantul and Gunungkidul (Jun and Dec 2024); Impala is a Quick model, but the pages name neither maker nor buying route.
FTP UGM lecturers trained farmer groups on aid "Impala" tractors (2024); a Dec 2025 column says Quick recruits from UGM and ITS. No formal agreement found.
Eight G 1000 two-wheel tractors from the envoy were handed out in Kulon Progo in Jul 2026 (snippet); G 1000 is a Quick model, maker not named.
Kemenperin cited 450+ dealers "dari Sabang sampai Merauke" (2017); Quick cited 15 branches and showrooms (2018) and 10 branches with 450 dealers (2021).
Quick's "only official online store", run by CV KHS (copyright 2016-2026).
